name: Snapmaker U1 + multiACE 8-color
description: 8-extruder virtual profile for multiACE post-processor. Based on stock Snapmaker U1 profile. Use only with multiace_postprocess.py post-script.
_note: Replace /path/to/multiace_postprocess.py with the absolute path on your machine. Set DAVINCI_U1_HOST env var to your printer IP before slicing.
